title: Upkeep for lang (2025)
description:
### To begin

* [x] `usethis::pr_init("upkeep-2025-11")`

### Pre-history

* [x] `usethis::use_readme_rmd()`
* [x] `usethis::use_roxygen_md()`
* [x] `usethis::use_github_links()`
* [x] `usethis::use_pkgdown_github_pages()`
* [x] `usethis::use_tidy_github_labels()`
* [x] `usethis::use_tidy_style()`
* [x] `urlchecker::url_check()`

### 2020

* [x] `usethis::use_package_doc()`
* [x] `usethis::use_testthat(3)`
* [x] Align the names of `R/` files and `test/` files

### 2021

* [x] Remove check environments section from `cran-comments.md`
* [x] Use lifecycle instead of artisanal deprecation messages

### 2022

* [x] Handle and close any still-open `master` --> `main` issues
* [x] `usethis:::use_codecov_badge("mlverse/lang")`
* [x] Update pkgdown site using instructions at <https://tidytemplate.tidyverse.org>
* [x] Update lifecycle badges with more accessible SVGs: `usethis::use_lifecycle()`

### 2023

* [x] `usethis::use_tidy_logo(); pkgdown::build_favicons(overwrite = TRUE)`
* [x] `usethis::use_tidy_coc()`
* [x] Use `pak::pak("mlverse/lang")` in README
* [x] Consider running `usethis::use_tidy_dependencies()` and/or replace compat files with `use_standalone()`
* [x] Use cli errors or [file an issue](new) if you don't have time to do it now
* [x] `usethis::use_standalone("r-lib/rlang", "types-check")` instead of home grown argument checkers;
or [file an issue](new) if you don't have time to do it now
* [x] Add alt-text to pictures, plots, etc; see https://posit.co/blog/knitr-fig-alt/ for examples

### 2025

* [x] `usethis::use_air()` <https://posit-dev.github.io/air/>
* [x] `usethis::use_package("R", "Depends", "4.1")`
* [x] Switch to the base pipe (`|>`)
* [x] Switch to the base anonymous function syntax (`\(x)`) 
* [x] Convert in-header chunk options to the newer in-body style used by Quarto:
`fs::dir_ls("vignettes", regexp = "[.][Rq]md$") |> purrr::walk(\(x) knitr::convert_chunk_header(x, output = identity, type = "yaml"))`
* [x] Switch to `expect_snapshot(error = TRUE)` instead of calling `expect_error()` without specifying `class =`

### To finish

* [x] `usethis::use_mit_license()`
* [x] `usethis::use_tidy_description()`
* [x] `usethis::use_tidy_github_actions()`
* [x] `devtools::build_readme()`
* [x] Add alt-text to pictures, plots, etc; see https://posit.co/blog/knitr-fig-alt/ for examples
* [x] [Re-publish released site](https://pkgdown.r-lib.org/dev/articles/how-to-update-released-site.html) if needed

<sup>Created on 2025-11-10 with `usethis::use_tidy_upkeep_issue()`, using [usethis v3.2.1.9000](https://usethis.r-lib.org)</sup>

title: Please make `translate_roxygen()` support translation of `R6::R6Class()` roxygen within methods
description:
Hello,

Thanks a lot for the very exciting work in the package.

I'm trying to initiate the translation of {torch} which mainly includes R6Class() with included methods.
Class do have roxygen, and child method do have roxygen as well. and they should not be mixed.

The (not) minimal example could be [R/distribution.R](https://github.com/mlverse/torch/blob/main/R/distributions.R) 

Is there any chance to have that support ?
Thanks a lot
